root_idea.summary: The supplied evidence centers on causing or making one resemble, conform to, or imitate another.
root_idea.development: No Maqāyīs or Mufradāt evidence was supplied, so no further root-level semantic development is established.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The form is Quran-attested and represents the Form III verb normalized to its classical perfect citation form.

senses.definition: To resemble, conform to, or imitate another.
senses.usage_conditions: A transitive Form III use describing resemblance, conformity, or imitation. The Quranic occurrence is the active imperfect plural form يُضَاهِئُونَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To treat someone gently, tenderly, or courteously; to behave gently toward him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported with بِـ in ضَاهَا بِهِ and also with a direct object in ضَاهَأَهُ.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Covers resemblance, conformity, and imitation, including the Quran-attested Form III usage.
Covers the distinct construction meaning to treat or behave gently.
